title: Show HN: Gitdot – A better GitHub. Open-source, written in Rust
summary: Gitdot is an open-source GitHub alternative built entirely in Rust, offering user signups, organization creation, private/public repositories, and GitHub repository import functionality. The project features a unique CLI-inspired web interface reminiscent of tools like fzf, vim, and broot.
problem_solved: Provides a self-hostable, open-source alternative to proprietary Git hosting platforms like GitHub
why_valuable: Built in Rust for performance and memory safety, offering developers freedom and control over their code hosting infrastructure without vendor lock-in
